MSHP_AllActiveProjWithTasks.MSHP_ExecutiveSummary: Significant progress on the upgrade path this week. Delivered a fix for the Unassigned sorting issue that was blocking the PHP and PM3 rollout, confirmed with the client that the custom skin issue is resolved on their side, and started investigation of the remaining Enterprise and DMS plugin blocker. Project updates were published in Rocketlane and reviewed with the client on the weekly technical call.

MSHP_ExecutiveKeyItemsList.Key_Item: Unassigned sorting fix: Delivered and validated the package update that corrects Unassigned list sorting and supports the planned PHP and PM3 upgrade path.
Client alignment: Weekly technical call confirmed skin resolution on the client side and identified the Enterprise and DMS plugin as the remaining upgrade blocker.
Next focus: Investigated the Enterprise and DMS plugin tickets shared by the client and published the weekly project updates in Rocketlane.
